title: gossypium hirsutum subsp. mexicanum
intro: Gossypium hirsutum subsp. mexicanum, commonly known as Mexican cotton, is a subspecies of cotton plant native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, alleviating skin conditions, and treating wounds. The therapeutic actions of Mexican cotton include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to promote healing and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of Mexican cotton include flavonoids, terpenoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and contribute to its potential use in traditional medicine.
